How do you keep notes for a long project?

Posted by tessellate in Working methods

I have been on the same project for two years. My notes are spread across three editors and a paper notebook, and I cannot find anything older than a month.

What has actually worked for you, not in theory but for a project that outlives your enthusiasm?

One file per week, and a single index page that I rewrite every Sunday. Boring, but I can find anything by date.

If the index is a chore, the notes are already lost.

I keep a decisions log. One line per decision, the date, and what we gave up by choosing it. The giving-up part is what makes it useful a year later.

2026-02-14 chose queue over direct call, gave up latency

Search beats structure. If your notes are plain text in one folder, grep is your index.

The sidebar carries navigation and advertising, which should never be translated as content.

Fixture page. Authored for this repository, not captured from a live site.
